Due to REDUCED CAPACITY you may be asked to leave if you are not on the court docket and be prepared for court proceedings may take much longer. Cases are heard on a first-come, first-served basis. For Wednesday Court nights the office will close at 2:00p to prepare for the evening session. For Friday Court days the office will close at 12:00p to prepare for the afternoon session.
